jobs_results.title: SRE / Devops Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Hi, we’re Fever
We’re excited you are checking out this job offer.

We are the leading global live-entertainment discovery tech platform with a clear mission: to democratize access to culture and entertainment.

How do we achieve our mission? Fever has developed a proprietary technology that inspires a global community of over 125M people through personalized and curated experiences in their local city whilst empowering entertainment and event creators to reach new audiences and enhance their experience.

Sounds amazing, right?

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

About the role

As a SRE / DevOps Engineers at Fever you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable and reliable infrastructures, with a keen focus on automation.

If you’re... experienced developing infrastructures using AWS services, have strong knowledge on how to build CI/CD pipelines and you build systems with a security-first mindset, well then you’re exactly what we are looking for!

Join us if you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are excited about pushing the boundaries of what's possible. This is an opportunity to have real impact in a high-growth global category leader.

About you

Must have skills
• Strong knowledge of DevOps culture, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.
• Strong knowledge of Linux administration, troubleshooting and automation using Python and bash scripting.
• Hands-On experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, etc)
• Experience using Kubernetes in production environments.
• Good understanding of Networking and HTTP reverse proxies (OpenVPN, Nginx).
• Professional proficiency in English. You’re able to communicate and collaborate with remote and multidisciplinary teams.

It would be nice if you have
• Database administration knowledge (MySQL & PostgreSQL)
• Experience working as a Site Reliability and Security Engineer.
• Knowledge building service infrastructures for Python/NodeJS environments.
• Knowledge of centralized logging techniques (rsyslog, ELK/EFK).
• An open-minded and passionate approach to technology.
• Experience working on agile environments.

Benefits & Perks
• 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences.
• Home office friendly anywhere in Spain.
• Relocation package for international candidates.
• Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth.
• Great work environment with a young, diverse team of talented people to work with!
• Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee's platform.
• English Lessons.
• Gympass Membership.
• Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary through Payflow.
• Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
• Base Salary: 35.000 - 70.000EUR

About the process

Fever aims to provide the best-fastest possible experience to our candidates. This is how it would look like:
• Talent Interview - 1h: An intro to Fever, our culture and a conversation about your background and experience.
• Technical Assignment: Your opportunity to demonstrate all you know! We would like to receive it back within 3 days.
• Team Interview - 1.5h: A discussion about your proposed solution to the technical challenge. And your opportunity to ask anything you need to know about your day to day at Fever.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
More than 3.5 billion people globally cannot obtain access to high quality health services due to poor health systems, inadequate infrastructure, and human resource gaps.​Cardo Health is an impact start-up with a mission to democratize access to healthcare – starting with emerging markets. With strained public healthcare systems and many uninsured inhabitants, there is an enormous potential to transform the health sector in these markets.

Local digital health start-ups, meanwhile, face challenges such as access to funding and often sub-optimal technology.

WHAT WE DO

Cardo Health addresses these challenges by investing in the most talented local entrepreneurs, providing them with funding, world-class scalable technology, and extensive operational know-how in digital health.

We are building our first Software Engineering team based in Barcelona that will be tasked with building a global platform delivering on-demand healthcare to most in demand communities.

Platform resilience and... up-time is super important and we are hiring a DevOps Team that can ensure we build a scalable, fault tolerant environment that enables us to release and deploy rapidly.

We have built a modern stack using, NodeJS, React, MySql, Github actions, Terraform for infra-as-code, K8s and Docker! We ar currently deployed onto AWS but are building for a multi cloud future as we deploy in multiple countries.

The DevSecOps expert owns the development delivery process and collaborates with the delivery team to continuously improve it. They will drive the team’s engineering practices in test driven development, continuous integration, and automated deployment. They are a hands-on team member who actively coaches the team to solve complex problems in order to increase speed of delivery, improve quality/security of code, and optimize processes for the development team. The DevSecOps expert delivers infrastructure-as-code deployment tooling and supporting services on multiple cloud providers along with metrics and login.

Responsibilities:
• Guides DevOps teams on speed of delivery, improving quality/security of code, and optimizing processesMentors and coaches the technical team
• Be hands on and engage in coding to help the team to develop his solution and solve all surfacing problems at hand Identifies and removes technical impediments
• Constantly looking for better ways of solving technical problems and designing the solution, not afraid of challenging the status quo
• Provides the team a roadmap for implementing software engineering practices for higher code qualityIdentifies bottlenecks in coding development and deployment processes
• Leads planning delivery time, code quality, and process efficiency improvement projects
• Executes on plan by building coding standardizations and automating processes for the organization
• Leads knowledge growth effort of platform configuration management and troubleshooting
• Collaborates with the rest of delivery team to deliver consistent and holistic solution to the organization

Key Skills:
• Seen as an expert within the technical components of the domains/products/journeys
• Excellent coding and scripting skills (Bash, Perl) and experience with implementing high-scale cloud architectures using modern, cloud-based container platforms (PaaS/SaaS)
• Experience of deployment automation solutions (i.e. Terraform. Puppet, Chef, Ansible)
• Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and cluster management tools like Kubernetes
• Experience with containers such as Docker, OpenShift and continuous integration and related tools such as Jenkins, Hudson, Maven, Ant, Git, Sonar, etc.
• Experience of integrating security in the CI, CD pipelines
• Experience in Agile Development and implementing CI, CD at scale Experience as a DevOps or SRE Lead on a cross-functional agile team
• Understands relationship with Product Owner, Scrum Master, Design Lead and rest of technical team.
• Experience managing technical priorities within the BacklogStrong communication skills with ability to align the organization on complex technical decisions
• Active coach and mentor whose goals are to grow and maximize the team’s potential
• High energy and passionate individual who inspires teammates to reach their maximum potential
• Excited about trying new solutions outside standard approved
• Embraces a culture of trust, free thought complete transparencyBrave and rebellious, willing to challenge status quo

jobs_results.title: Global DevOps Engineer (all genders)
jobs_results.description:
Full-time

Are you ready for new challenges in an international and innovation-driven environment where you can make a difference? Apply and join our team, be curious, learn, grow, and develop your career together with us. We promise: you are in for a special ride!

The location of the role is in; Oviedo

For this position, we are open to both junior & senior candidates

About the job

As a Global DevOps Engineer, you will report directly to the Head of Digital & Cloud Solution Delivery. In this position, you will play an important role in the Digital Transformation of RHI Magnesita, supporting our development of technical solutions. You will primarily deploy and maintain cloud infrastructure, using infrastructure as code through DevOps methodologies. By being a part of the Digital & Cloud Solution Delivery department, you will support our main initiatives. You will work in alignment with the rest of our teams and other IT areas, following corporate standards, proposing new ideas, and... keeping all activities well-documented.

In addition, your tasks will include
• Receiving and synthesizing data about our customer business and technical requirements and addressing them with technical architecture(s)
• Understanding our customer technical environments and mapping architecture/digital transformation solutions to customer business outcomes
• Supporting our teams in building the DevOps development cycle and deploying/maintaining their infrastructure in Azure with your technical expertise
• Providing guidance and support with technical expertise to the teams for building our cloud infrastructure and developing features for our cloud solutions

About You

You are a strong communicator with a collaborative attitude. With your great enthusiasm and creative mindset, you bring new ideas to the table, not only as an individual but also together with your colleagues. You work well in cross-functional teams and are not afraid to take responsibility and make decisions. With your hands-on mentality, structured approach and analytical skills, you proactively seek to improve the status quo. You see change as something positive, can adapt quickly and you like to courageously help shape the future of RHI Magnesita.

What we expect from you in terms of

Education & Skills
• A bachelor's or master’s degree in information technology, computer science/engineering, or similar areas of relevance
• Knowledge using modern Web UI technologies – Angular JS, HTML5, React, CSS3 & Angular
• Knowledge of security best practices in infrastructure, application, IAM, or data platform solutions
• Knowledge of Microsoft tools and platforms like Active Directory, System Center, Power BI, Azure, Office 365, etc.

Languages
• English – Advanced

Work Experience
• Some years of relevant professional experience
• Experience in architecture, design, configuration, and deployment within the Microsoft Azure platform

Why you should work for RHI Magnesita

You will perform in a customer focused environment. We live innovation and appreciate an open and pragmatic way of working. From our leaders we expect to drive our further transformation, to engage our people and to give direction. RHI Magnesita is a company where you can be yourself and where not only your resume and experience, but also your personality counts. We aim for global consistency in compensation policies, but also consider local common practices. RHI Magnesita is committed to support its employees through various means to enable the best possible performance.

We offer
• A permanent contract
• Flexible working hours for the perfect balance between your professional and personal life
• RHIM Academy for your ongoing learning & development, including full LinkedIn Learning catalogue
• Meal allowance
• Private medical insurance
• Possibility of up to 50% home office
• Empowerment to take responsibility and forge your own career success
• Opportunities to learn, lead, and build something new with colleagues from around the world

Sounds like you?

At RHI Magnesita everyone is welcome and encouraged to apply. We evaluate applications based on required qualifications and regardless of gender identity, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation, marital or partnership status. At RHI Magnesita we appreciate the value of diverse teams.

We kindly ask you to submit your application online and in English. Due to data privacy reasons, applications via e-mail cannot be taken into consideration. Should you have any questions about this position, please contact us at: talent.europe@rhimagnesita.com

Agencies may only submit candidates for positions for which they have been invited to do so by the Head of Talent Acquisition Europe. All unsolicited resumes sent to us will be considered property of RHI Magnesita and our company will not be held liable to pay a placement fee.

About RHI Magnesita

We are the acknowledged technology leader in the refractory industry. Our company is defined by people. We are committed to diversity and know that multiple approaches, perspectives and backgrounds fuel creativity and innovation. It is our aspiration to build a workplace culture where everyone feels valued, engages, and can enjoy a truly inclusive environment and the diverse voices of our employees are heard. We foster a collaborative culture that cherishes ideas and determination to add value for our customers. Our leadership style encourages open-mindedness, reliability, pragmatism, and innovation.

Find & follow us: www.rhimagnesita.com

LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube

jobs_results.title: ServiceNow (MyServices) DevOps Lead
jobs_results.description:
We're on a mission to optimize IT and revolutionize the business. To achieve this, we're seeking a talented Agile DevOps Lead to join our team and make a global impact through our ServiceNow platform. By understanding and addressing demand requirements, you'll enable new features and constantly seek ways to improve the delivery of a best service to our customers.

As a ServiceNow Agile DevOps lead, you'll play a crucial role in enabling ServiceNow landscape delivery. You'll be part of strategic decisions to empower our colleagues across all BI locations worldwide and collaborate directly with ServiceNow and other onboarded clients.

In your role as a ServiceNow Agile DevOps lead, you'll work alongside other roles like architects, team leads, business process consultants, other development scrum teams within the BI environment, which will continuously expose you to the latest technologies and help you advance your skills as well.

Tasks and responsibilities
• In your new role, you... concentrate on empowering the development teams based on a solid understanding of business requirements, as well as ServiceNow core technology and industry trends.
• You’ll be monitoring and forecasting the multiple Products backlogs into the planned Sprints & Releases
• Additionally, you ensure that BI architectural governance is followed in any demand implementation and contribute to keep it up to date.
• With your expertise, you contribute to governance processes by providing direction for innovative technologies within your ServiceNow environment.
• Lastly, you assist in making informed decisions based on a thorough understanding of how process or system changes may impact other processes, systems, or people. You also encourage strategies for continuous improvement leveraging last technologies.

Requirements
• Master’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology or a comparable qualification
• + 3 years of relevant experience in ServiceNow administration, development, and solution architecture, with expertise in ITSM, ITBM, HR Service Delivery, and SecOps skills as a bonus
• A proactive attitude that challenges the status quo, embraces a continuous improvement mindset, and demonstrates strong analytical and organizational skills.
• Ability to work under pressure, manage time effectively, and coordinate with cross-functional international teams.
• Expert on Agile methodologies: SCRUM.
• Knowledge of architecture, integrations, automation, and security, with a focus on user experience and a customer-oriented approach
• Excellent communication skills in English with a willingness to travel

#IamBoehringerIngelheim because…

We are continuously working to design the best experience for you. Here are some examples of how we will take care of you:
• Flexible working conditions
• Life and accident insurance
• Health insurance at a competitive price
• Investment in your learning and development
• Gym membership discounts

If you have read this far, what are you waiting for to apply? We want to know more about you

jobs_results.title: Senior Engineer, DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Your mission

You, as a driven agile team member, will be working closely with the development teams to implement and support their continuous integration, in order to ensure stable and reliable releases of our platform. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining our container-based microservice infrastructure, to improve the availability and resilience of our services. With your motivation and knowledge in the latest cloud technologies, like Terraform and Kubernetes, you can create a scalable and solid architecture.

About the Team

The Platform area is responsible for developing and maintaining our internal APIs, services, infrastructure and security. The teams in the area support other Product teams by providing tools & services to enable the smoothest delivery possible of our Products. With a strong sense of ownership, you will ensure the timely and efficient delivery of high-quality code, a high level of performance and design whilst also developing innovative... compelling and cutting-edge systems that support our operations.

What you’ll do
• Development of our tools and improving systems and server setups to guarantee stability and security
• Collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance our system and develop new features
• Enhancement of our terraform codebase and infrastructure pipeline to support rapid feature delivery
• Monitoring and upgrading our systems and server setups to guarantee stability and security
• Mentor junior team members

Who you are
• Possess strong expertise in Cloud and AWS-based infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3, SQS, etc.).
• Have a minimum of 3 years of experience with Docker, Kubernetes/ECS, and Terraform.
• Demonstrate proficiency in CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI, Travis CI, Bitbucket Pipelines, or similar.
• Showcase experience in building and maintaining real-time application monitoring and deep knowledge of troubleshooting hotspots.
• Exhibit familiarity with languages like Bash, Python and Golang. Kafka knowledge is preferred

With your motivation and knowledge in the latest cloud technologies, like Terraform and Kubernetes, you can create a scalable and solid architecture.

About the Team

The Platform area is responsible for developing and maintaining our internal APIs, services, infrastructure and security. The teams in the area support other Product teams by providing tools & services to enable the smoothest delivery possible of our Products. With a strong sense of ownership, you will ensure the timely and efficient delivery of high-quality code, a high level of performance and design whilst also developing innovative... compelling and cutting-edge systems that support our operations.

What you’ll do
• Development of our tools and improving systems and server setups to guarantee stability and security
• Collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance our system and develop new features
• Enhancement of our terraform codebase and infrastructure pipeline to support rapid feature delivery
• Monitoring and upgrading our systems and server setups to guarantee stability and security
• Mentor junior team members

Who you are
• Possess strong expertise in Cloud and AWS-based infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3, SQS, etc.).
• Have a minimum of 3 years of experience with Docker, Kubernetes/ECS, and Terraform.
• Demonstrate proficiency in CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI, Travis CI, Bitbucket Pipelines, or similar.
• Showcase experience in building and maintaining real-time application monitoring and deep knowledge of troubleshooting hotspots.
• Exhibit familiarity with languages like Bash, Python and Golang. Kafka knowledge is preferred

jobs_results.title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Cloud DevOps Engineer (AWS)

Description -

The Company

HP is a Fortune 100 technology company with $58+ Billion in revenue, with over 50,000 employees operating in more than 170 countries around the world. We provide technology and services that help people and companies address their problems and challenges, and realize their possibilities, aspirations and dreams. We apply new thinking and ideas to create simpler, more valuable and trusted experiences with technology, continuously improving the way our customers live and work.

Position background

In the GTM analytics COE our mission is to deliver impact by building machine learning products to optimize pricing and marketing investments and provide guidance to our sales organization.

Within the Cloud Infrastructure team, we are ensuring that our Data Science teams have all the technology assets they need to perform their duties and that our Big Data environment is secure and has an up time of 99.99999%.

As a Cloud Engineer you... will contribute to the success of our team thru the development of new automation and maintenance of existing ones for which you will ensure their compliance with security policies. As well you will help maintain and deploy infrastructure elements.

We offer an international experience, collaborative culture, top rate experience in AI and ML and opportunity to create significant real-world impact.

What you will do
• Build internal services and systems with embedded automation.
• Enhance and maintain existing services.
• Create platform agnostic services.
• Create, maintain and monitor cloud infrastructure elements.
• Identify and automate manual processes.
• Implement monitoring tools using Grafana, Prometheus, ELK or similar.
• Participate in DevOps Game Day events.
• Assist with and own remediation of escalated security events and incidents.
• Participate in Cyber Security Reviews and ensure compliance with the privacy office recommendations.
• Implementation Security and Compliance Policies and Standards, Disaster Recovery Plans, Data and Information Backup and Recovery Guidelines.

What you will need:
• Bachelor’s in computer engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field
• 2+ years on a similar role.
• Ability to work under pressure as well as in autonomous mode.
• You have strong problem-solving skills and you can lead complex projects.
• Experience operating cloud-based infrastructures (AWS).
• Experience with modern application lifecycle management tools (Git, Visual Studio, Intellij, Code Reviews).
• Experience with container orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS EKS
• Experience with IaC frameworks such as Terraform, Cloud Formation, Ansible, Puppet.
• Work experience in CI/CD environments
• Experience with Linux Operating Systems
• Proficient in at least one of the following languages: Python, Java, Node.js, Bash, Go.
• Experience in working with AWS services such as IAM, KMS, CloudWatch, S3, EC2, VPC, RDS.
• Strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem solving ability.
• Experience in deploying REST API services.
• Experience in maintaining the security of cloud environments (AWS).
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills directed to technical and non-technical team members.

Nice to have:
• Experience with Could SQL & NoSQL databases.
• Solid knowledge of cyber security standards and frameworks.
• Experience on implementing disaster recovery solutions.

Who We Are

At HP, we believe in the power of ideas. We use ideas to put technology to work for everyone. And we believe that ideas thrive best in a culture of teamwork. That is why everyone – at every level in every function, is encouraged to think big, have original ideas and express and share them. We trust anything can be achieved if you really believe in it, and we will invest in your ideas to change lives and the way people work. This vision is what sets us apart as a company. At HP, we work across borders and without limits. Global virtual teams share resources, pool their big ideas to solve our biggest business opportunities. Everyone is valued for the unique skills, experiences and perspective they bring. That’s how we work at HP. And this is how ideas and people grow.

jobs_results.description:
Looking for a move to sunny Barcelona?

We are working exclusively with a retail giant who are innovating the retail space with their one of a kind product. They are now seeking ambitious individuals to be a part of transforming the way the world shops with cutting-edge AI, ML and robotic technology.

We are seeking experienced DevOps Engineers to join their team based in Barcelona. Your day to day will include an array of responsibilities such as; Cloud Engineering activities, Infrastructure and Environments Deployment Architecture, Automation of everything that can be automated and developing a deep understanding of different solutions/tools related to their mission.

Your skills and experience...
• Expertise in Ansible, AWS, terraform
• Solid knowledge in Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment
• Experienced in DevOps automation, configuration management and Infrastructure-as-a-Code
• Good understanding of logging and/or distributed tracing concepts and tools

What they... can offer YOU...
• Very competitive salary package
• Private Health Insurance, Life Insurance and an Gym discounts
• Flexible working hours with short Fridays and reduced hours in August
• Tech talks and internal training including English and Spanish language courses

If this sounds interesting please apply with your CV and I will be in touch to discuss the opportunity further

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer with CMS
jobs_results.description:
Infosys is a global leader in technology services and consulting. We enable clients in more than 50 countries to create and execute strategies for their digital transformation. From engineering to application development, knowledge management and business process management, we help our clients find the right problems to solve, and to solve these effectively. Our team of 190,000+ innovators, across the globe, is differentiated by the imagination, knowledge and experience, across industries and technologies that we bring to every project we undertake.

In the role of System Analyst, you will interface with key stakeholders and apply your analytical proficiency across different stages of the Software Development Life Cycle including Requirements Elicitation, Application Architecture definition and Design. You will play an important role in creating the functional specification artifacts. You will also deliver high quality test scenarios/cases and support activities related to... implementation, transition, and warranty. You will be part of a learning culture, where teamwork and collaboration are encouraged, excellence is rewarded, and diversity is respected and valued.

Location for this position is Krakow, Poland . This position may require 25 % travel.

Release Management and Application Deployment has the following key responsibilities:
• Interact with clients and other stakeholders to obtain and verify information.
• Test, maintain spec, monitor, and troubleshoot content on CMS software with associated devices and software.
• CMS process documentation and updating with version control.

Skills:
• Experience in CMS applications, preferably in DevOps role, Windows servers, MS SQL, Play Framework with Scala support. Infrastructure and access management, DMZ and Intranet server management.
• Must have in-depth knowledge of Content Management.
• Good understanding of Web applications, information architecture, CMS, and integrated technologies
• Ability to map loosely defined business requirements to specific functional specifications which can be mapped to CMS implementation.
• Familiar with Azure DevOps, SSO, myPrivacy, Privacy for ABB and HE, Sitefinity, Azure DevOps, Jira, Scrum tools.
• Should have worked in multiple CMS implementations.
• Responsible for Release Management and Application Deployment
• CMS Platform administration and tuning
• Ability to evaluate current state of architecture, platform and provide architectural recommendations to improve performance, scalability, and reliability.
About Us
Infosys is a global leader in consulting, technology, and outsourcing solutions. We enable clients, in more than 30 countries, to stay a step ahead of emerging business trends and outperform the competition. We help them transform and thrive in a changing world by co-creating breakthrough solutions that combine strategic insights and execution excellence.

We offer:
• Competitive salary + quarter bonuses
• Multisport card and MyBenefit program
• Medical care
• Career in the multinational company
• Opportunity to take part in international projects and gain experience with various businesses
• Set of social benefits to choose from
• Salary adequate to your competencies
• Training program

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer (Open to remote)
jobs_results.description:
SAVANA (www.savanamed.com) is an award-winning, international medical company aiming to accelerate health science by putting into the hands of healthcare providers the power to unlock all of the clinical value embedded within existing Electronic Health Records (EHRs) with Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing. Always ensuring maximum privacy and security.

Founded in 2014, Savana is an international medical company that has developed a scientific methodology that applies Artificial Intelligence (AI) to unlock all the clinical value embedded within Electronic Health Records' free-text (EHRs). With the largest AI-enabled, multi-language, multi-center research network in the world, Savana generates customized descriptive and predictive, High-quality Deep Real World Evidence research studies. Engineered by doctors for doctors, the company is built following the highest privacy-by-design standards.

Savana operantes in more than 160 hospitals, 5 languages, 15 countries... and has already improved more than 6 clinical practices with more than 100 employees from 16 nationalities. It constitutes a clinical research ecosystem that aims to advance personalized and precision medicine worldwide.

DevOps Engineer at Savana

Savana is looking for a DevOps Engineer to play a key and exciting role in our fast-growing company, serving Spanish, English, German and French speaking markets. Based remontly in Spain, he/she will participate on the challenging project of expanding Savana worldwide as well as serving our home market, Spain.

Major Accountabilities where this role is involved:
• Create secure, scalable, and reliable infrastructure.
• Actively participate in the software development lifecycle, offering infrastructure insights and solutions.
• Work on ways to automate and improve development and release processes.
• Ensure infrastructure is up and running according to business requirements.
• Participate in the design and architecture of efficient infrastructure solutions.
• Follow and enforce technical guidelines and best practices in Agile methodologies.
• Operate according to Security Policies, Procedures and Manuals.
• Proactively report potential incidents and suggest improvements.

Skills, Experience and Qualifications required:
• Proven experience in cloud infrastructure systems, particularly AWS, with an emphasis on secure and resilient design. 3-5 years of previous experience in a similar role.
• Good understanding of modern software architectures, including Microservices.
• Expertise in build and deployment automation.
• Advanced coding skills in Python / BASH.
• Advanced knowledge in networking and computer security principles.
• Experience working under SCRUM/Agile methodologies.
• Assertive, pragmatic, and fast learner with excellent problem-solving capabilities.
• Proficiency in English.
• Proactive and quality driven oriented.
• Team oriented with good interpersonal skills.
• Flexible working attitude open to changes.
• Ability to work in a multinational, multidisciplinary and fast-growing environment.

If you are practical, experienced, proactive, independent, articulate, passionate about facilitating the digital transformation of healthcare, fascinated by Artificial Intelligence, the future of medicine and determined to solve healthcare's biggest problems. You are a Savaner. Join us!

We offer:
• Work with a multidisciplinary team of clinicians, computer engineers, computational linguists, mathematicians, designers, medical Natural Language Processing expert programmers and other disciplines. We are a team of professionals with a common goal: to blend the knowledge of all of us to seek excellence in our purpose. Coming from very different disciplines, we want everyone to learn from everyone, creating a unique entity that moves towards the transformation of health through Artificial Intelligence.
• An opportunity to provoke a positive impact. We seek to improve health on the planet through technology and to help people and health institutions. Our employees and collaborators strive to provide our users with the necessary tools and support to achieve a more accessible and egalitarian global health. We care about our environment and we are willing to improve it.
• An environment to express yourself as you are and enjoy what you know. We defend individuality to form a richer and more plural "ecosystem". Be yourself and tell us what you have learned and how could we use it together to help us achieve our purpose. If you like what you do, we like to work with you.
• Competitive salary conditions, flexible culture and a development framework to growth your career. People are our main asset, so we invest in training and development and recognize and compensate for achievements and valuable work. We trust in the talent and commitment of people and focus on objectives and results, so we are flexible in our way of working, providing a framework to reconcile our personal and professional lives.

Details from this job description are not to be used for marketing purposes. Savana does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Savana via e-mail, the Internet or directly without a valid written search agreement will be deemed the sole property of Savana, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Savana.

Medsavana S.L. (“Medsavana”) will process the personal data you provide to us during the selection process (the “Candidate’s Personal Data”) in order to manage your curriculum data and the selection process you are applying to. You can exercise the rights of access, rectification or erasure, restriction of processing, objection, portability, and to object automated individual decisions at the registered office of the company indicated or in the email dpo@savanamed.com. For more information, please refer to the privacy policy section on our webpage: https://www.savanamed.com/es/curriculum
